gui.guhs.guhdex.info.normal: The good old guh. Everywhere in the Guhmension and in guh caves.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mint: A fresh mint-green guh. Smells like toothpaste.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.snow: A white guh who loves the cold peaks.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.brontosaurus: A guh with a very long neck. Guh-saurus!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.teckel: A sausage guh with six little legs. Very long, very happy.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ghost: A see-through guh who only shows up at night. Boo-guh!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.starry: His fur is a night sky full of glowing stars.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rainbow: Keeps changing color. Nobody knows how.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ender: Rarity: Rare (only in the Guh End, after beating Overlord Mika)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ender: Enderguh: black and purple with dragon wings. He lives in the Guh End and only lets himself be tamed once you have beaten Overlord Mika (1 in 8 nibbles, or 1 fried nibble). Saddle him and fly!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.koning: The King Guh on his throne in the legendary Guh Castle. Royal purple, a white mane, a little mustache. His outfit is in the treasure room of his castle: go find it!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.reisguh: Rarity: Common (at every portal and in big places)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.reisguh: The Travel Guh: a guh conductor. Right-click to discover him; after that you can travel between all the Travel Guhs you know. There's one at every Guh Portal, at the Guh Castle and in the big places: Guhwarden, Snuggledale, the Guh Fair, Guhland, the Balloon Festival and the Guh Circuit.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.poortwachter: The Gatekeepers of the Guh Castle. They only let guh friends in...
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.showguh: The Show Guh hosts the Chonk Pageant: dress up a model guh for the theme and let the jury decide. With Show Rosettes you can buy the Showstar outfit.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.raceguh: The Race Guh lends you a racing guh: three laps through the rings, over WAHOOG pads and against your own ghost guh.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mepguh: The Whack Guh hands you a whacker: whack the Mikas on the 4x4 board, but never the guh!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.djguh: The DJ Guh plays the colors first: dance them back in the right order. One wrong step and the music stops.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.golfguh: The Golf Guh lends you a club for 9 holes of guh mini golf. Every hole has three tee mats: green for easy (close to the hole), pink for medium and red for hard (all the way at the back). On hard she puts out extra pink slime bumpers and her guh windmill spins twice as fast. Hold right-click, let go, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.smulguh: The Munch Guh lends you her big platter: catch the falling food for a whole minute, and stay away from Mika's Grease.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.visguh: The Fishing Guh lends you a rod for the fishing contest. You get to keep the special guhfish!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mijnguh: The Miner Guh lends you a pickaxe for the cheese veins, which you won't find anywhere else.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bibliothecaris: The Librarian of the Guh Library knows every guh tale. Read them all on the lecterns!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.zeemeerguh: Rarity: Rare (Guh Sea, Deep Guh Sea)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.zeemeerguh: The Merguh: a guh with a fish tail! Swims super fast. Tame him, saddle him and ride underwater.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.golden: A shiny golden guh. Extremely rare!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.brococolief: The guh of the Guh Village. Wears pink, of course.
gui.guhs.guhdex.title: Guhdex
gui.guhs.guhdex.welcome: Welcome to the Guhmension! Here, have a Guhdex: fill it with every guh you meet. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wolk: Rarity: Rare (Floating Guh Islets and the Cloud Meadow)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wolk: Fluffy, with a little cloud on his head: if he falls, he floats. Lives on the floating islets and in the wild in the Cloud Meadow. After 8 cheese nibbles he trusts you and catches you when you fall!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mager: Rarity: Pitiful (in the cells of the Nibble Cellar)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mager: A gray, skinny guh the Mikas haven't given a single nibble in months. Give him one and he's WAHOOG again right away! (You get your star for the rescue.)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.vahoege_ender: Overlord Mika's freed Enderguh: gold and pink, with dragon wings. You get him after your first victory, and Enderguh Eggs after that. Saddle him and fly!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kaasmoerasguh: Rarity: Only in the Cheese Swamp
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmoerasguh: Spotted green and yellow, as if he rolled through the mud (he did). Lives only in the Cheese Swamp. Tame him with cheese nibbles: it makes him even chonkier!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kikkerguh: Rarity: Common (Cheese Swamp, Blossom Lake and the ponds of Babbledale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kikkerguh: Ribbit-guh! Hops around the Cheese Swamp in pink, mint or yellow. Gobbles up cheese moths and then spits out a glowing moth nibble. Likes cheese nibbles too. At Blossom Lake and in Babbledale he sits on a lily pad: come too close and he plops away. He ribbits loudest in the evening.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmot: A teeny-tiny Mika moth with holey-cheese wings. Flutters around cheese and lamps and snatches cheese nibbles off the ground. Nyeg! Frogguhs think they're delicious.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.moerasheks_mika: Rarity: Rare (stilt hut in the Cheese Swamp)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.moerasheks_mika: A Mika in a pointy hat. Throws Chonk-Be-Gone Potions (making you Unwahoog for a bit) and nibbles her own swamp cheese when she's hurt. Drops swamp cheese!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.boswachterguh: Looks after the Chonkwood Forest and all the guh families. Sells chonkwood, saplings, guh nests and the ranger outfit.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelplukker: Picks nibbleberries all day long and trades them for all sorts of things. Careful: sometimes she eats the harvest herself.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.grillguh: A guh chef with a sky-high chef's hat and an apron. The Mikas swiped his Fire Starter Cubes! Help him and he'll teach you his secret grill recipe.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.asguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Ash Vale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.asguh: A gray, sooty guh with glowing cheeks from the Ash Vale of the Barbecuether. Fire doesn't bother him. Feed him a cheese nibble and he glows with joy!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rookguh: A sad, skinny little guh ghost made of smoke, lost in the Barbecuether. Feed him cheese nibbles (from your hand or thrown): with every nibble he gets rounder and pinker, and then he floats home all WAHOOG. Hit him? Nyeg, never!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluisguh: An extra fluffy pink guh with a fluffy tuft and fluffy cheeks. Lives only in Snuggledale and would just love to be cuddled. Tame him with cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.burgemeesterguh: Mayor Chonkworth, with a top hat and a golden chain of office. Organizes the Great Cozyfest and then a season party every season. Ahem!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kruimel_mika: Rarity: Sneaky (only when they're snatching something)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kruimel_mika: A little Mika covered in cookie crumbs. Never fights, only snatches: party cakes, tea sets, garlands... Lure him away with a treat and he runs off giggling.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.cocotje: Rarity: Unique (in her little house in Snuggledale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.cocotje: Coco is always losing something. They hang on her chonk. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bakkerguh: Baker Crusty has baked cheese nibble bread his whole life, and he's started to look a bit like it: golden brown and always covered in flour. Help him with the orders and every guh in the dale gets nice and WAHOOG again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.juf_knuffel: Looks after all the baby guhs of Snuggledale. She knows four lullabies and always has a little bottle of cheese milk in her apron. Baby guhs crawl off everywhere: will you help them back into their cradles?
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.theeguh: Pours tea for anyone who wants to sit and chonk for a while. She always stirs with her big teaspoon and knows every kind of tea. Bring your tame guhs along for a tea party: snug!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kapperguh: Rarity: Unique (Snip & Chonk, in every Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kapperguh: Curly the Barber snips, curls and blow-dries every guh wahoog pretty. He sets his own curls every morning with a cheese nibble in the curlers. A guh is never too chonky for a new hairdo, he always says: just not wahoog enough.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.boerinneguh: Farmer Haybale looks after all the farm animals, with a piece of straw in her mouth. She has a chore for you every day, and she sells brushes, feed, seeds and watering cans. Nyeg, let's get to work!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhschaapje: Rarity: Rare (Guh Farm, sometimes in the Guh Meadows)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhschaapje: A little cloud of fluff wool with a guh head and round guh ears. Pet it, brush it and feed it: a happy lamb drops a tuft of fluff wool. Baa!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.knabbelkippetje: Rarity: Rare (Guh Farm, sometimes in the Cheese Flats)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelkippetje: A round, cheese-yellow chick with big guh eyes. When it's happy, it lays a nibble egg in a little nest. Cluck cluck, wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhkoe: A chonky cow with cheese spots (with holes!), a pink guh snout and two little horns. Make her happy and hold out an empty bottle: cheese milk! Moo!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sterrenkijkerguh: Rarity: Rare (Guh Observatory, Guh Peaks and Chonk Cliffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sterrenkijkerguh: Looks through his giant telescope at the guh constellations every night. The Big Nibble is his favorite. Sells star lanterns and his stargazer outfit for wishing stars.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ballonguh: Rarity: Rare (Balloon Festival, Guh Fields and Pink Puffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ballonguh: Flies his guh hot-air balloon over the Guhmension and tells you about everything you see. High, higher, WAHOOG! After every flight, a stamp on your Balloon Stamp Card.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.opa_guh: Rarity: Rare (campsites, and on his bench in Snuggledale)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.opa_guh: Loves sitting by the campfire and tells a story from the old days every night: about Mikas, cheese nibbles and why guhs have such big ears. Twelve stories, one per night. Nyeg, nighty-night!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.badmeesterguh: Rarity: Rare (Snuggle Pool, by the Guh Sea)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.badmeesterguh: The lifeguard of the Snuggle Pool. He keeps an eye on the three slides, teaches you how to wash a guh until it shines, and blows his whistle when you run. Tweeet! His little shop: swim caps, bathrobes and bubble foam for Ducky Coins.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.ijscoguh: Rarity: Drops by (Guhmension, also on the Snuggledale square)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.ijscoguh: Jingles the Ice Cream Guh cycles through the Guhmension with his ice cream cart. Ding-a-ling! He sells cheese ice creams for cheese nibbles, with an extra flavor every season. The guhs chase after him. After a day he cycles on.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sjoelguh: Rarity: Unique (in the Shuffle House in the Guh Meadows)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sjoelguh: Granny Nyegshuffle has played shuffleboard since she was a little guh. She knits her own cardigans, pours tea for everyone who comes to watch and knows exactly how hard to push a puck: "Not too soft, not too hard, just wahoog, sweetie!" She never gets cross, not even when you slide every puck into gate 1. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.doolhofguh: Rarity: Unique (The Guh Maze, Guh Fields)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.doolhofguh: Mr. Chonkwiggle has trimmed hedges his whole life, and his mustache curls just as nicely as his maze. The Mikas keep hiding stolen cheese nibbles in it, and then the guhs aren't WAHOOG enough anymore. For every game he grows a brand-new maze, and he makes the nibbles float and sparkle above the hedges so you can spot them from afar. Getting lost is allowed, chonk!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.katapultguh: Rarity: Unique (on the wall of the Nibble Catapult, Chonk Cliffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.katapultguh: Captain Floopguh guards the Nibble Catapult. Across the gorge the Mikas have built their forts, full of stolen cheese nibbles. He never fires anything hard at them: only fluffballs, as soft as a guh. "FLOOP! And there goes the fort. Nobody gets hurt, the Mikas run off giggling and the nibbles are free again. WAHOOG!" His eyepatch is actually a heart. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.spelleiderguh: Rarity: Unique (The Nibble Games, Guh Meadows and Pink Puffs)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.spelleiderguh: Coach Wahoogaroo referees The Great Hexathlon. She always has her clipboard with her and knows exactly who hops the fastest, throws the farthest and pins the prettiest. The Mikas have snatched the cheese nibbles, so: six games, a thousand points per game, and who will be the wahoogest guh?
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pinguh: Rarity: Uncommon (only in the Guh Polder)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pinguh: A guh in a penguin suit! A third of the wild guhs in the ice-cold Guh Polder are Pinguhs. There are classic Pinguhs (black with a white tummy and a little orange beak), fancy Emperor Pinguhs (a bit bigger, with golden cheeks) and, very rarely, a gray fluffy Pinguh chick: all babies look like that! Waddles around all chonky and slides over the ice on his belly. Tame him with cheese nibbles and he'll happily glide along with you on the Eleven Guhtowns Tour. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schaatsmeesterguh: Rarity: Unique (in Guhwarden, at the start of the Eleven Guhtowns Tour)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schaatsmeesterguh: Skate Master Guhglide has an orange bobble hat, a whistle on a cord and two little skates around his neck. He lends you guh skates, gives you a Stamp Card and blows the starting whistle: eleven towns, eleven stamps, it giet oan! He sells warm winter sweaters for Town Stamps. He always says: 'The chonkier you are, the smoother you glide! You just have to be wahoog enough, and hot chocochonk helps with that.'
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.stempelguh: Rarity: Eleven of them (one in every town of the Eleven Guhtowns Tour, each with its own little hat)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.stempelguh: In every town along the Eleven Guhtowns Tour stands a Stamp Guh with a stamp in his paw. Arriving in the right order? FLOMP! Another stamp on your card. Every Stamp Guh wears the hat and scarf of his own town.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.circuitguh: Rarity: Unique (in the Pit Palace of the Guh Circuit)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.circuitguh: Coach Wahoog-Vroom knows every bend of her three tracks by heart. With her headphones on and her golden stopwatch around her neck, she shouts "WAHOOG! One more lap!" all day long. She lends you a racing guh on Rainbow Road, the Chonk Track or the Cheese Mountain Track. Watch out for the Mika Snatchers: they snatch your WAHOOG speed, hee hee hee!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.brandweerguh: Rarity: Unique (the fire station on Career Street in Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.brandweerguh: Fire Chief Splashguh has the red helmet with the golden star and the finest soot mustache in the whole dale. He puts out every marshmallow campfire that flares up too chonky, and gets little guhs down from trees (they love climbing up, but getting down... nyeg). Help him out once and you get your own fire helmet and jacket. Nee-naw nee-naw, WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.politieguh: Rarity: Unique (the little police station on Career Street in Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.politieguh: Inspector Wahoogsby solves every case with his big magnifying glass and a bag of cheese nibbles (for thinking). His biggest case: The Case of the Nibble Thief! A Mika snatched the town's nibble supply and left chonky paw prints behind. With him, Mikas are never punished, only hugged really tight in the cuddle cell.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.apothekerguh: Rarity: Unique (the little pharmacy on Career Street in Snuggledale town)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.apothekerguh: Doctor Sniffleguh has a white coat, a stethoscope, a little mirror on his head and a red nose that's always a bit runny (that's where his name comes from, achoo). With sniffle herbs from his herb garden and cheese milk he makes the yummiest cheese milk potion in the Guhmension: it makes every sniffly little guh WAHOOG again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.bouwvakkerguh: Rarity: Unique (by the half-built house in some guh villages)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bouwvakkerguh: Bob the Guhbuilder is building the prettiest house in the village, with a pencil behind his ear and a hammer on his belt. Only the roof isn't finished yet: he needs planks, and lunch (a builder without cheese nibbles never gets wahoog). Can we fix it? YES, WE CAN!
gui.guhs.anderevadsjes.leeg: You don't have any other tame critters yet, nyeg! Tame a squeaksqueak mouse, a Shelly or another little animal and you'll see here where it is.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.getemd: Today I picked %s as my human. Good choice, if I do say so myself, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.geboren: Today I was born! I'm still very small, but my chonk grows every day.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_knuffel: Did you know a cuddle is worth exactly three cheese nibbles? I just did the math.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_guhmensio: Did you know the air in the Guhmension smells like cotton candy? I checked.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_guheinde: Today I was in the Guh End. I wasn't scared. Just a teeny bit. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.eerste_huisje: My house is called %s. I think it's the prettiest name in the whole world.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.niveau_lief: Today I got sooo WAHOOG: %s and I are sweet chonkies together, nyeg!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.niveau_mega: %s and I are now MEGA sweet chonkies together. I've never been this wahoog before.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.band.niveau_zielsguh: %s is my soulguh bff 5evr <3. I pressed a little heart into my fur, forever.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.opgraven: Did you know there are cheese nibbles in the ground at %s? I found out myself. With my very own pawsies!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.farmen: Today I harvested at %s. I planted a seed back too, or the ground gets sad.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.opruimen: Did you know %s is now the tidiest house in the whole world? That's thanks to me. And a little bit to the chest.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.dieren: Did you know a guh cow says moo when you pet her? Then I say nyeg back. That's how we chat at %s.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.bakken: It smells like freshly baked cookies at %s. I don't know who did that. (Me.)
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.vissen: Did you know fish don't like cheese nibbles? I do. That's why I fish at %s, and eat the nibbles myself.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.waken: I'm guarding %s. If a Mika comes, I squeak as loud as I can. Then I push him away very gently. Sweet, but strict.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.plukken: Did you know a flower doesn't get mad if you pick one? I asked at %s. It didn't say anything, so it's fine.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.lampjes: At %s the lights go on when it gets dark. That's me. I'm kind of like the sun, only smaller.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.oppas: Today I looked after someone at %s. It felt warm in my chonk. That's what being sweet feels like, I think.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.zeldzaam: Today I found %s at %s. WAHOOG! I sniffed it three times before I put it in the chest.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_knab: Today for the first time I pushed a nibble ball around until the nibble rolled out. Nom! I'm a ball champion, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_glij: Today I went down the slide for the first time. Wheee! My ears flapped all over the place.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_tunn: Today I hid in the fluffy tunnel for the first time. Nobody saw me. Well, almost nobody.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.eerste_wip_: Today I went on the swing for the first time. So high! I was so WAHOOG, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.knabbelbal_: I pushed the nibble ball with my snoot at least ten times. It rolls so nicely!
There was a cheese nibble in the ball. Now it's in my tummy. Chonky!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.glijbaantje: I went down the slide three times in a row. Again? Again!
The climbing frame has little ears, just like me. That's why I love it so much.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.tunnel_1: It's soft and dark in the tunnel. The perfect hiding spot, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.tunnel_2: I had to giggle so hard when I got found. That's what gave me away!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.speelgoed.wip_schomme: On the seesaw I went up and down, up and down. It made my tummy all tickly.
Someone gave me a push on the swing. I almost flew up to the clouds!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.eerste: Today I got to have a sleepover in the Guh Room for the first time. In a belly! It's warm and pink in there and there's a little rug. Very snug, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.logeren_1: I'm on a sleepover in the Guh Room again. I miss my human a little. A teeny tiny bit. Okay, quite a lot.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.logeren_2: In the Guh Room I took a nap on the pink rug. Wahoog soft!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.guhkamer.logeren_3: Sometimes I hear the belly rumble when I'm lying in the Guh Room. That's just a lullaby, right?
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.beauty: My human walked the catwalk and I clapped my pawsies so hard they turned red. Ten points from me!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.race: We raced today! I had to hold on to my ears, we went so fast. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.meppen: Whacking Mikas with a soft little hammer. They didn't even mind, they just giggled. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.disco: We danced on the light-up floor! Now I know all the colors by heart. Almost.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.golf: My human hit a little ball into a little hole. I almost ate the little ball. Almost!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.smul: Snacks fell from the sky! It was the best day of my life, and I only snatched three.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.vissen: We fished for guhfish. Now I smell like fish, but I'm very proud of it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.verstop: We played hide-and-seek. I hid behind my own chonk. Nobody found me, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.bakkerij: We baked cookies! I got flour on my snoot and a cookie in my cheek pouch. Shhh, secret.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.creche: We looked after baby guhs. They're so tiny! I felt like a really big chonky guh.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.theehuis: A tea party! I stuck out my pinky. I don't have a pinky, but it went pretty well.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.kapper: A hairdo with curls went by. I want curls too. Or a quiff. Or both!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.sterrenwac: We looked at the stars. There was one shaped like a cheese nibble, I'm sure of it.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.ballon: We flew in a hot-air balloon! I looked down and saw the whole Guhmension. My tummy tickled.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.knuffelbad: We went down the slide: wheee! Now I'm a wet little chonk, but a happy wet little chonk.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.grijpmachi: A claw machine! I wanted to crawl inside to rescue the plushies. Wasn't allowed, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.sjoelen: We played shuffleboard with Granny Nyegshuffle. I cheered for every puck, even the ones in the wrong slot.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.doolhof: We walked through the maze. I knew the way! I just didn't say, or it wouldn't be exciting.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.katapult: Shooting fluffballs at a Mika fort! BOOM! The Mikas laughed, so that counts as sweet.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.knabbelspe: Sports! My human ran and I ran along in my head. Now I'm very tired.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.elftocht: We skated past all the towns. My pawsies are cold, but my heart is warm.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.samen.spel.circuit: Racing laps on the circuit! I sat on the back and shouted WAHOOG at every bend. Every. Single. Bend.

gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.timmerguh: Rarity: One in every Snuggledale town (at the building site, at the end of the street past Coco's house)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.timmerguh: The Carpenter Guh builds a Guh House at the edge of every Snuggledale town: a house shaped like a guh head, with ears for a roof. His little helmet is always a bit crooked and he hums with every tap of his little hammer. Will you help with the ear roof? Then he'll teach you to build houses yourself, in all three sizes. Building together is twice as chonky, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.baltoguh: Rarity: One per player, after the story of Nomguh
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.baltoguh: Half guh, half wolf: gray fur, pointy wolf ears, a pale belly and a real guh snoot. Once a bit of an outsider, now the hero of Nomguh. In the snow he runs super wahoog (even when you ride him), and with the Sniff! button in the guh menu he sniffs out the way to your house or your spawn point: follow the glowing pawprints! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.boris: Rarity: One, on Nomguh's old boat
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.boris: A real goose (not a guh!) with a fur hat and a Russian accent. Da, little guh... honk! He lives with Baltoguh on the old boat in the frozen bay and always knows what to do. His wisdom: a guh doesn't only think with his paws, but with his heart too.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.steele_mika: Rarity: One, at Nomguh's starting line
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.steele_mika: Nomguh's show-off champion sled leader, with a red racing cap, goggles and a gold medal. I'M the fastest, nyeh-heh! He always wants the glory, but everybody just giggles at him sweetly. After the story you can race him along the route.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.muk: A big, sweet polar bear guh with a blue scarf. Muk talks for two (because Luk never says anything) and loves fishing in the little ice pond. Cuddles are free!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.luk: A big, sweet polar bear guh with a green scarf and a little fishing rod. Luk never says anything, but nods, waves and cuddles all the more. Muk translates.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.rosy: Rarity: One, in Nomguh's little hospital
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.rosy: A little pink baby guh in a tiny bed, with a yellow scarf and a red nose. She had the nibble cough and sneezed super cutely (achoo-nyeg!). Thanks to the medicine chest from the mountain hut she's all better again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.witte_wolfguh: Rarity: Only at the darkest moment of the journey
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.witte_wolfguh: A white wolf guh who glows softly, like a little star in the snow. She only appears when it's darkest, and looks at you very kindly. Then she's gone... but you'll never forget her.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mewtwo: Rarity: One per player (after the story of Clone Island)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mewtwo: Professor Nibbleclone wanted to clone a guh that could eat twice as many cheese nibbles. It didn't turn into a clone, but something new: the Guhtwo! Light gray-purple, with a purple tail with a little bulb and a tube from the back of his head to his neck, but with chubby guh cheeks and guh ears. He floats a little above the ground in a soft purple glow, floats over small gaps with you on his back, pulls cheese nibbles and bits and bobs within 8 blocks toward him with nibble telekinesis, and eats everything x2: double hearts from every snack! One per player, after the story of Clone Island. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mew: Rarity: Only around Clone Island (after the story)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mew: A teeny-tiny pink floating little guh with big blue eyes and a long thin tail with a little bulb. Mewguh giggles at everything, does little somersaults in the air and is the Guhtwo's best friend. She only lives around Clone Island and only shows herself once you know the story of the Clone Tank. You can't tame her (she belongs to everyone), but you can wave! Hee hee, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.knabbelkloon: Rarity: One (in his little office on Clone Island)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelkloon: Professor Nibbleclone is the smartest and most scatterbrained guh of the Guh Sea. His glasses are always crooked, his lab coat is full of nibble juice stains and his notes are everywhere. He wanted to clone a guh that eats twice as many cheese nibbles... and in a very strange way, it worked. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.wolkenhoeder: Rarity: One in every Cloud Chapel
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.wolkenhoeder: A soft cloud guh with a golden shepherd's crook and a teeny-tiny halo. He looks after the Snuggleheart and knows exactly what it needs to beat again.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.stitch626: Rarity: One per player, after the story of Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.stitch626: Experiment 626! A blue alien guh with big ears, four paws and an extra pair of little arms. He was made to be TOO CHONKY... but a guh can never be too chonky: the Chonkiness Scanner goes right off the charts to INCALCULABLY WAHOOG. He makes a mess sometimes, but he never hurts anyone. He climbs up walls, hangs upside down from the ceiling, carries two things at once with his extra arms (double hauling for chores!) and plays the ukulele: "Aloha, nyeg!" After Lilo-guh's story he can be tamed once with a cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.lilo_guh: Rarity: One in every stilt house on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.lilo_guh: A small, stubborn guh girl with long black hair, a red dress with white leaves and a pink hibiscus behind her ear. She loves Elvis guh music, surfing and weird blue guhs. She adopted 626-guh from the shelter, because: ohana means family!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.nani_guh: Rarity: One in every stilt house on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.nani_guh: Lilo-guh's big sister. She takes care of everyone: Lilo-guh, the house on stilts and now 626-guh too (and his mess). A bit strict, but super sweet. She wears a flower in her bun.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.tikiguh: Rarity: Unique (one on every Guhwai'i Surf Beach)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.tikiguh: Nobody knows what Tiki Guh looks like without his mask. He always holds it in front of his snoot, on a bamboo stick, with palm leaves on top. "A tiki is something you feel, not something you see," he says. He sells the finest tiki goodies for Seashell Coins: torches, masks, little lanterns and even a little radio with hula music. Under his grass skirt there's just a chonky guh tummy. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pluisvinkje: Rarity: Common, in flocks, in the Guh Fields, the Pink Puffs and the Guh Meadows
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluisvinkje: A round pink-and-white ball of fluff with guh ears! Fluff Finches fly in little flocks behind their leader and love sitting in guh blossom trees. Sometimes a soft fluff feather drifts down, especially when you give them seeds. Sneak up closer, or the whole flock flutters away. Tweet-nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kaasmeesje: Rarity: In the Chonkwood Forest and the Cheese Flats
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kaasmeesje: A yellow chickadee with a cheese stripe (with holes!) on its belly and a lilac guh cap. Loves hanging upside down under the leaves and pecking at ripe nibbleberries (it leaves them hanging for you, sweet, huh?). Give it berries and it sings: chick-a-dee-cheese!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guh_uiltje: Rarity: Rare, in the Guh Peaks and the Chonkwood Forest (awake at night)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guh_uiltje: By day the Guh Owlet sleeps all puffed up on a branch. At night its little eyes open and glow in the dark. Its ears are real guh ears, and its little head turns all the way around to keep an eye on you. Hoo-hoo... nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.zeemeeuwtje: Rarity: Along the Guh Sea, the Deep Guh Sea and on Guhwai'i
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.zeemeeuwtje: Mine! Mine! A cheeky but sweet little seagull. Hold up a fish (or bread) and the whole beach comes circling over your head. A fish on the ground? Gone! But they leave your other stuff alone. Loves bobbing on the waves.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhxolotl: Rarity: Common (shallow water of the Guh Sea and the Cheese Swamp). Gold: very rare!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhxolotl: A guh who is an axolotl: a round guh head, guh eyes, a little snoot, blushies and pink fluffy gills. They come in pink, mint, choco, white and (very rarely) GOLD. Tame it with a little guhfish and scoop it into a bucket. Plays dead if you hurt it (shame on you!).
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guh_eendje: Rarity: Common (ponds, the Guh Sea and the Cheese Swamp)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guh_eendje: A mama duck with guh ears and a little row of fluffy yellow ducklings behind her. Every duckling follows the duckling in front. Quack-nyeg! Likes seeds, bread and cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.knabbelvlindertje: A little butterfly with a teeny-tiny guh head and wings full of nibble spots. In cheese yellow, pink, mint and lilac. Flutters from flower to flower and sleeps on a little flower at night.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.glimguhtje: Rarity: Only at night (Cheese Swamp and Guh Meadows)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.glimguhtje: A teeny-tiny round guh with a little light in its tummy. At night they float in dreamy circles above the grass and the water. At sunrise they softly glow away.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.lieveheersbeestje: Rarity: Common (near flowers and Guh Gardens)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.lieveheersbeestje: A ladybug with spots shaped like guh heads. It loves landing on your Guh Gardens and makes them grow a tiny bit faster. Sweet little helper!
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.polijsten: Did you know the stones at %s are shiny now? I polished them with my pawsies. Tink tink.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pluisegeltje: Rarity: Common in the Chonkwood Forest
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluisegeltje: A little hedgehog with soft, fluffy spines: they never prick, they're really cuddle spines. When it gets a fright it rolls up into a fluffy ball (sneak, and it stays calm). It adores sweet berries and walks right through berry bushes without an ouch. Tame it with sweet berries!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guh_konijntje: Rarity: Common in the Guh Meadows (and white in the Snowguh Tundra)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guh_konijntje: A round little bunny with long floppy ears, a wiggly nose and a pompom tail. They come in pink, white, choco and gray. It hops around everywhere and runs off if you come stomping up too loudly. Tame it with a carrot or a cheese nibble. Once tamed it does a happy binky: hop hop!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pluiseekhoorntje: Rarity: In guh blossom trees and the Chonkwood Forest
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pluiseekhoorntje: A fluffy little squirrel with a huge curly tail and tufts on its ears. It hides little stashes of cheese nibbles in the ground all over the place (look for the little dirt mounds!). Tame it with cheese nibbles: then it sits on your shoulder and now and then digs up a stash for you.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.shuckle: Rarity: Rare: around Clone Island, and very occasionally deep in the Holey Cheese Caves
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.shuckle: Not a guh! A red shell full of cheese holes, a yellow head with beady eyes and yellow feet poking out of the holes. Very, very slow, and very shy: get too close and it crawls into its shell. Sneak up and give it sweet berries. Once tamed it turns berries into a yummy berry juice, and in a Guh House it polishes stones.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kraakguh: Rarity: Rare: at night in the Palewood, near a tree with a Creaking Guh Heart
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kraakguh: A guh made of pale wood, with moss on its head. It belongs to a Creaking Guh Heart and only comes out at night. It only moves when nobody is looking: look at it and it stands stock-still. Look away... creak! All it wants is to give you a wooden hug (that makes you slow for a moment). Hitting it doesn't help: cheese resin just drips from its tree. At sunrise it crumbles away, and also when you chop its heart out of the tree.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kraak_mika: Rarity: Very Rare: at night in the Palewood, near a tree with a Soured Guh Heart
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kraak_mika: A Mika made of pale wood with yellow-green eyes. It comes out of a soured heart. Just like the Creakguh it only moves when nobody is looking, but it doesn't come to hug: it comes to shove. NYEG! It doesn't hurt. After a few good whacks it has had enough and crawls back into its tree until the next night.
